sourcePolicy: All questions in this pack are Ready2Go original draft practice items unless an individual record states otherwise. No official JAMB past-question corpus is included. Human subject-matter and answer-key review is required before public release.

questions.question: A car travels 120 m in 6 s at constant speed. What is its speed?
questions.explanation: Speed = distance ÷ time = 120 ÷ 6 = 20 m/s.

questions.question: Which instrument is connected in series to measure electric current?
questions.explanation: An ammeter is connected in series so the circuit current flows through it.

questions.question: The SI unit of frequency is…
questions.explanation: Frequency is measured in hertz (Hz), equivalent to cycles per second.

questions.question: Which expression gives kinetic energy for a mass m moving at speed v?
questions.explanation: Kinetic energy is one-half times mass times the square of speed.

questions.question: A 6 Ω resistor carries a current of 2 A. What is the potential difference?
questions.explanation: From V = IR, V = 2 × 6 = 12 V.

questions.question: The SI unit of force is which?
questions.explanation: Force is measured in newtons.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Newton’s second law relates resultant force to what?
questions.explanation: Resultant force equals mass multiplied by acceleration.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Ohm’s law relates voltage, current and what?
questions.explanation: For an ohmic conductor at constant conditions, V = IR.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Electrical power is calculated as which product?
questions.explanation: Electrical power P equals V times I.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Frequency is the number of complete oscillations per what?
questions.explanation: Frequency is measured in hertz, or cycles per second.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Average speed is calculated as what?

options.C: Total distance divided by total time

questions.explanation: Average speed is distance travelled per unit time.

questions.question: Refraction occurs when a wave changes direction because it changes what?

options.B: Speed on entering a different medium

questions.explanation: Refraction results from a wave speed change between media.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Density is mass divided by what?
questions.explanation: Density is mass per unit volume.

questions.question: Linear momentum equals what?
questions.explanation: Momentum is the product of mass and velocity.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: In a simple series circuit, the current is what through each component?

options.A: Different by definition at every point

questions.explanation: The same current passes through series components.

questions.question: The principle of conservation of energy states that energy cannot be created or destroyed but can do what?
questions.explanation: Energy is conserved in an isolated system.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Heat transfer through direct molecular interaction is called what?
questions.explanation: Conduction transfers thermal energy through microscopic interactions.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Like magnetic poles do what?
questions.explanation: Like poles repel and unlike poles attract.

questions.question: The half-life of a radioactive isotope is the time taken for what?

options.C: Half the unstable nuclei in a sample to decay
options.D: The sample to become twice as heavy

questions.explanation: Half-life describes exponential radioactive decay.
